Example linkage summary

Source: R/data.R
LinkageSummary.Rd

A list containing a linkage summary object and a differential linkage result from a mock dataset

linkage_sum_tiny

A linkage summary object created with mock data.

linkage_diff_tiny

Results from running test_differential_linkages() on the mock linkage summary object.

Usage

data("LinkageSummary")

Format

An object of class list of length 2.
